finding.title: Registered model complete-HTML count remains the local compression count
finding.explanation: The registered helper intentionally reuses exact independently authenticated published module descriptors, allowing different compatible lossless compression from local module construction. It returns graph from those real bytes but returns document.modelPresentation unchanged, retaining byteCounts.completeHTML for the local composition. This underreports admissible actual returned HTML cost and can mislead the later presentation planner.
